account.title: My account
account.lede: Optional. An account lets you save items, follow areas and see the claims you sent. It never holds your voter ID.
account.overviewSavedText: Publications, findings and booths you saved.
account.overviewSubscriptionsText: Areas and series you get email alerts for.
account.overviewClaimsText: Claims you sent and their moderation status.
account.overviewSettingsText: Name, language, alerts and deleting your account.
account.savedEmpty: You haven’t saved anything yet. Use “Save” on a publication, finding or booth.
account.subscriptionsEmpty: You aren’t following any area or series yet.
account.notifyEmail: Email me when something I follow is published
account.dangerText: This removes your profile, saved items, followed areas, unpublished claims and your sign-in. Published claims stay published without your name.
account.deleteUnavailable: Account deletion needs the ElectraLens API, which isn’t connected in this environment. Your saved items and follows can still be removed one by one.

auth.signInLede: We’ll email you a one-time sign-in link. No password, and no voter ID ever.
auth.linkSent: Check your inbox: we sent a sign-in link to {email}.
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
auth.failed: Sign-in didn’t work. Please try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Please request a new one.
auth.staffNote: Staff sign in through the operations console.
